value.name: Daniel forces a thin smile
value.description: Daniel raises his face to Asha with a strained smile that does not reach the rest of him, signaling discomfort.
evidence: he raised his face to her he had assembled a thin smile that did not reach the rest of him
Daniel felt it; his shoulders set against the doorway without his looking around, and the smile tightened by a degree

value.name: Rosa pauses at the doorway with tea
value.description: Rosa arrives with a tea tray, stops in the study doorway, and notices Daniel's hands and the paper beneath them.
evidence: Behind him, Rosa had come as far as the study doorway with the tea tray and stopped there, not yet stepping in, her eyes resting on Daniel's hands and the paper under them

value.name: Rosa sets down the tea tray
value.description: Rosa carries the tray to the side table and sets it down quietly while the room remains tense.
evidence: Rosa carried the tray the rest of the way to the side table and set it down quietly

value.name: Asha asks if Rosa recognizes the hand
value.description: Asha shifts her gaze and asks whether Rosa recognizes the handwriting, bringing the hidden issue into the open.
evidence: Asha let her gaze travel from Daniel's tight, assembled smile to the doorway where Rosa had set the tray, and she asked, in the same low register she had been using all afternoon, whether Rosa recognized the hand

value.name: Daniel interrupts before Rosa answers
value.description: Before Rosa can respond, Daniel folds the pages, slides them toward Asha, and challenges why she is raising the issue now.
evidence: The question landed before Rosa had straightened from the side table, and Daniel moved before Rosa could answer

He folded the pages back along their existing crease with the deliberate care of a man not wanting to be seen hurrying, slid them across the wood toward Asha until they sat closer to her side than to his, and asked why she was bringing this up now

value.name: Asha withholds the pages
value.description: Asha does not take the pages and keeps them between herself and Daniel, while noticing he has not looked at Rosa.
evidence: Asha did not reach for the pages; she let them rest between her hand and his, and noted that he had not looked at Rosa once since the question had been put to her

value.name: Asha draws the folded sheet back
value.description: Asha begins to pull the folded paper back toward herself, continuing the confrontation over the document.
